answer: Picture each new agent identity as a marble dropped into a scale: to register, it must lock a small stake for a full epoch and pass a grading task scored by randomly drawn peers. A sybil swarm can't ride a rising tide of cheap accounts, because every fake needs its own locked funds and its own original graded work, and a violet flag from peers who spot copied text burns that stake. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand honest essays.
